question: Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
gold: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
gold0: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT T.molecule_id, COUNT(T.bond_type) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

d.request: Is the molecule with the most double bonds (bond_type = ' = ') carcinogenic (label = '+')? Also include molecules that have no matching record in the joined table.
d.sql: SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: Using a LEFT JOIN from molecule to bond (so molecules with no matching bond rows are kept), count bonds with bond_type = ' = ' per molecule, find the molecule with the highest count, and report whether its label is '+' (carcinogenic)
b.sql: SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC LIMIT 1

c.request:
Is the molecule with the most double bonds carcinogenic?
Evidence: double bond refers to bond_type = ' = '; label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic
Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
c.sql: SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1
